name: io.github.KIvanow/spend-brake
title: Spend Brake
description: Capped search, maps and other paid APIs, or Spend Brake admin, over MCP.

environmentVariables.name: BRAKE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Spend Brake virtual key (sb_live_…); its caps apply to every call

environmentVariables.name: BRAKE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Spend Brake proxy, e.g. https://proxy.spendbrake.dev

environmentVariables.name: BRAKE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Spend Brake admin API, for the budget tool and for --admin, e.g. https://app.spendbrake.dev

environmentVariables.name: BRAKE_ADMIN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Admin token (sbt_…) for brake mcp --admin, as its own MCP entry
